"Educators used TeamVision in post-scenario debriefs to discuss team performance with students." (p. 11)

paper_code_entries.value: learning_or_skill_development — debriefing supports reflection and consolidation of practised skills (PDF p. 3).
quotes: "The debriefing process allows participants to reflect on their actions, discuss mistakes, and consolidate learning through guided reflection and feedback, enhancing understanding and application of the skills practised during the simulation [27, 103], and enabling formative assessment of both individual and team performance [52, 68]." (p. 3)

paper_code_entries.value: mixed_or_transitioning — educators control the evidence while nursing students inspect it during debriefing (PDF p. 3).
quotes: "Educators can filter and customise data visualisations to fit their approach, while (C) students view performance analytics on a shared screen during the debrief." (p. 3)

paper_code_entries.value: coordination_or_memory_gap — educators could not reliably hold all relevant team behaviour in memory while preparing and facilitating debriefs (PDF p. 2).
quotes: "Yet, debrief educators often rely solely on their memories and observations, which can result in the omission of crucial technical skills and team dynamics, such as nurse-doctor or nurse-patient communication, essential for positive patient outcomes [65]." (p. 2)

paper_code_entries.value: process — the study measured how phases and visualisations were used in debrief sessions (PDF p. 12).
quotes: "Using interaction data and video recordings from the shared screen, we annotated the phases and visualisations used in each session." (p. 12)

paper_code_entries.value: artifact — interviews assessed perceived usefulness, trust, and accuracy of the representations (PDF p. 12).
quotes: "For RQ3, we applied a similar thematic analysis to post-hoc interviews with educators and students, focusing on their perceptions of usefulness, trust, and accuracy." (p. 12)

paper_code_entries.value: structuring — TeamVision gave debrief sessions more structure and focus (PDF p. 14).
quotes: "Several educators reported that TeamVision enhanced the structure and focus of their debrief sessions." (p. 14)

paper_code_entries.value: problematizing — the sociogram prompted students to confront missing communication links and areas for improvement (PDF p. 15).
quotes: "Most students (n=10) appreciated the sociogram for identifying areas where communication could improve, helping them reflect on who they communicated with and who they might have neglected." (p. 15)

paper_code_entries.value: contingency — the displayed support responds immediately to the educator’s phase or action selection (PDF p. 10).
quotes: "Selecting a phase or action dynamically updates the visualisations and indexes a 20-second video snippet." (p. 10)

paper_code_entries.value: distributed_support — educators curate the representations and students inspect them together on a shared display (PDF p. 3).
quotes: "Educators can filter and customise data visualisations to fit their approach, while (C) students view performance analytics on a shared screen during the debrief." (p. 3)

paper_code_entries.value: hybrid_or_multi_model — Whisper transcription and a fine-tuned BERT classifier jointly produce communication-network meaning (PDF p. 9).
quotes: "To create this epistemic network, students’ speech data were transcribed using OpenAI Whisper [78] and coded with a fine-tuned BERT-based model [19]." (p. 9)

paper_code_entries.value: llm_era — the scaffold-producing path includes OpenAI Whisper alongside a fine-tuned language model (PDF p. 9).
quotes: "To create this epistemic network, students’ speech data were transcribed using OpenAI Whisper [78] and coded with a fine-tuned BERT-based model [19]." (p. 9)

limitations: "In terms of generalisability, TeamVision was designed specifically for a healthcare simulation, which may limit its applicability to other domains." (p. 18)
"Moreover, the impact of TeamVision in our study is limited by its short-term, real-world application." (p. 18)

"This study does not capture the extended influence of the AI-powered system on teaching and reflection practices or long-term outcomes as learners were exposed to only a single high-fidelity simulation." (p. 18)

"Finally, TeamVision’s technical limitations should be acknowledged, as they may influence the interpretation of data and affect the usefulness, accuracy and trustworthy of information, potentially hindering broader adoption." (p. 18)
boundary_conditions: "While it could be adapted for other team-based environments, modifications would be needed." (p. 18)
"Additionally, the design focused on fostering non-technical skills such as teamwork and communication." (p. 18)

limitations: "Participants raised concerns about the scalability of the system, noting that manually reviewing each intent cluster for every query would be impractical." (p. 13)
"For instance, LLM-generated intents may reflect social biases embedded in language models, potentially amplifying or overlooking the needs of certain user groups." (p. 13)
"Another key issue around intent quality involves the tradeoff between novelty and plausibility." (p. 13)
"First, our automated evaluation pipeline showed moderate agreement with human judgments, particularly for borderline cases." (p. 14)
"This suggests that our approach is useful for identifying clear successes or failures but may require human oversight for ambiguous cases." (p. 14)
"Second, we intentionally removed intents related to image or video content requests from our taxonomy, as our framework primarily focuses on textual information to be evaluated by LLMs." (p. 14)
"Furthermore, we parsed only SERP snippets, without the actual content of each result." (p. 14)
"Third, our implementation used search logs and SERPs from a Korean commercial search engine on limited query categories, which may limit generalizability." (p. 14)
"Different search engines with varying result formats or other languages might yield different intent distributions and evaluation outcomes." (p. 14)
boundary_conditions: "We began with a set of short-head queries—frequently searched, brief (1-3 words) queries that are often under-specified yet can exhibit substantial variability in user intent [18]." (p. 8)

"From the set of a year-long search logs of a commercial search engine (Dec 1st, 2023 - Nov 30th, 2024), we randomly selected 655 queries in three topic categories: Shopping, Location, and Knowledge." (p. 8)

"We recruited four search domain specialists from a commercial search service company, each with moderate to extensive experience in designing and executing evaluation processes (minimum 1 year experience, maximum 16 years; on average 7 years)." (p. 11)
"We further envision that our approach could evolve beyond evaluation of single-turn, static queries to support session-level evaluation of search by modeling intent progression." (p. 14)
